notes.title: FPVSIM Summer Update: Bando scene + Improved drone dynamics
notes.notes:
Welcome to the beautiful summer of 2025! Two main updates in this release

[olist]
[*] Added the long awaited factory/bando scene!
[*] Improved drone dynamics and collision models
[/olist]
Enjoy!
